pairs.question: Si confessionem boni operis non in nobis Deus operatur, cur per prophetam dicitur: Confessio et magnificentia opus eius?
pairs.answer: Ab illo enim nobis omnia bona, gratia praeueniente, donantur.
pairs.derivation: Author poses a real question (cur ... dicitur ...?) and answers it himself. Setup kept from the conditional clause so the 'cur' question has its grounds; dropped the leading framing connective 'nam' and capitalized 'Si'. Answer ends at the first full stop; the following sentence ('Nam nihil boni operis dedimus...') elaborates rather than answering, so it is cut.

pairs.question: Quid enim ex se ille latro meruit, qui de faucibus crucem ascendit, de cruce paradisum adiit?
pairs.answer: Reus quidem ille, et fraterno sanguine uenit cruentus, sed diuina gratia in cruce mutatur.
pairs.derivation: Author asks what the thief merited of himself and answers it: he was guilty, yet changed by grace on the cross. Question quoted in full to its '?'. Answer is the single following sentence; it is the last sentence of the section, so nothing follows to cut.
